name: Ashwagandha
description: Root of Withania somnifera, a nightshade-family shrub; contains steroid-like withanolides and alkaloids

status.usStatus: Dietary supplement · not an approved drug

note.text: Reports from Iceland, the US and India describe jaundice 2 to 12 weeks after use; 3 people with prior liver disease died.

bullets: **In rats,** effects on sex hormones, reproduction, thyroid and immune system (DTU)
**In people,** the mechanism is not established
Liver injury described in case series

practical.routes: By mouth (root extract capsules) in trials
practical.soldAs: Dietary supplement; not FDA reviewed before sale

regulatory.text: No approved drug; sold as dietary supplement
Denmark: illegal to sell as a food
UK review ongoing; no final advice yet

references: DTU National Food Institute, risk assessment of Withania somnifera root, May 2020
Am J Mens Health, ashwagandha in aging, overweight men, Mar 2019
Hepatol Commun, ashwagandha liver injury case series, Oct 2023
